svg.text: Floor: T1 cap 2 · T2 cap 4 · T3 cap 6 · T4 cap 4 (RESERVED)
T2: fits, capacity 4 — best so far
→ T2 wins. Best-fit protects the big tables
scan is LOCK-FREE — the answer is a hint
the re-check inside the monitor is what makes the
lock-free best-fit scan safe to use ✓
honest: one method bills, pays AND frees the table
honest: money is double, tax rate is hard-coded
split into generateBill() + settle() to fix both
THE ORDER FSM — Order.transitionTo() rejects every skip
never from SERVED — food already left the pass
Skips are impossible: the guard lives in the entity, so every
caller — service, demo, a future REST layer — inherits the rule.
Self-transition (from == to) is allowed, so a retried
"mark READY" is idempotent rather than an error.

g.text: for food that may never arrive; the
One guard in the entity beats a check
Same reasoning as "no refund without a sale".
Fix: synchronize transitionTo, or hold the
status in an AtomicReference and CAS it.

svg.text: ① best-fit table scan (lock-free hint) → ② re-check + flip status inside synchronized(table) → ③ the AVAILABLE / RESERVED / OCCUPIED cycle → ④ generateBill's SERVED gate → ⑤ the PENDING→PAID order FSM and its CANCELLED exits

g.text: ① A table has exactly one status, flipped only under its monitor.
③ No state skips in the order FSM.
④ PAID always frees the table.
